a.xlink:title: --- stage: build script: - echo "Using global cache configuration" - mkdir -p .cache vendor - echo "build artifacts" > .cache/build.txt - echo "vendor libs" > vendor/libs.txt

--- stage: test cache: - key: "${CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG}-gems" paths: - vendor/ruby policy: pull - key: "${CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG}-pip" paths: - ".pip-cache" policy: pull - key: static-test-data paths: - test/fixtures policy: pull script: - echo "Using multiple cache entries" - echo "Testing with cached dependencies" - ls -la vendor/ruby || echo "Ruby cache not found" - ls -la .pip-cache || echo "Pip cache not found" - ls -la test/fixtures || echo "Test fixtures not found"

--- stage: test cache: key: "${CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG}-build" paths: - dist/ policy: pull script: - echo "Using pull-only cache policy" - ls -la dist/ || echo "No cached dist found" - echo "Running tests with cached build artifacts"

--- stage: test cache: - key: global-cache-key paths: - ".cache/" policy: pull - key: "${CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG}-test" paths: - coverage/ policy: push script: - echo "Using both global and job-specific cache" - mkdir -p coverage - echo "test coverage" > coverage/index.html

--- stage: deploy cache: key: "${CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG}-${CI_JOB_NAME}-v1" paths: - ".deploy-cache/" policy: pull-push script: - echo "Using complex cache key with job name and version" - mkdir -p .deploy-cache - echo "deployment state" > .deploy-cache/state.txt
--- stage: deploy cache: {} script: - echo "This job has cache disabled" - echo "No cache will be used or saved"

--- stage: build cache: key: static-build-cache paths: - build/ - ".npm/" policy: push script: - echo "Using static cache key" - mkdir -p build .npm - echo "build output" > build/app.js - echo "npm cache" > .npm/cache.txt

--- stage: build cache: key: "${CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG}-build" paths: - dist/ - node_modules/ policy: push script: - echo "Using dynamic cache key with branch name" - echo "Branch: $CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG" - mkdir -p dist node_modules - echo "distribution" > dist/bundle.js - echo "dependencies" > node_modules/.cache

--- stage: build cache: key: dependencies-${CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG} paths: - ".bundler/" - ".yarn/" policy: push script: - echo "Using push-only cache policy" - mkdir -p .bundler .yarn - echo "bundler cache" > .bundler/config - echo "yarn cache" > .yarn/cache.txt - echo "Only writing to cache, not reading"

--- stage: build cache: key: files: - Gemfile.lock - package-lock.json prefix: "${CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG}" paths: - vendor/bundle - node_modules/ policy: pull-push script: - echo "Cache key based on lockfile checksums" - echo "Key changes when dependencies change" - mkdir -p vendor/bundle node_modules - echo "gems" > vendor/bundle/cache.txt - echo "npm packages" > node_modules/.package-lock.json
